thread.title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life • Tsuihou Sareta Cheat Fuyo Majutsushi wa Kimama na Second Life wo Ouka Suru. - Episode 4 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters enjoyed the comedy, especially the exaggerated contrast between serious and goofy material.
The art and animation were repeatedly praised, with some viewers also appreciating the environmental world-building details.
Some commenters liked the central character interactions and found several characters appealing, but felt the revenge-focused subplot weakened the episode.
Multiple commenters considered the writing tonally inconsistent and the revenge storyline overly tropey, distracting, or boring.

notes: The title and body explicitly identify the requested show and episode 4. Reddit exposed 109 total comments; 10 substantive comments were reviewed. Opinions are paraphrased and spoiler-free.
